body.justification: The result gives honest whole-set coverage and an automatic continuous fourth-root-to-root-\(n\) geometric adaptation law.
body.gap: Numerical-bootstrap regularization, general nonsmooth local-minimax bounds, weak-IV asymptotics, and existing uniform set-coverage or constrained-bootstrap results do not provide this fixed-relevance quadratic-contact whole-set hull and its continuous loss elbow under one score-inversion rule.
body.consumer: Applied sensitivity analyses receive one confidence hull that remains valid without diagnosing whether the leakage constraint is nearly binding.
